name: Happiness Of The Wicked The
overview: Scripture reveals that the happiness of the wicked is fleeting and ultimately deceptive. While figures like Haman may experience moments of joy and boast in their prosperity, as seen in Esther 5:9-11, their confidence is misplaced. The Psalmist's reflection in Psalms 73:17-19 shows that understanding the end of the wicked exposes their precarious position, marked by sudden destruction and terror. This teaches believers that the apparent success and happiness of the wicked are limited to this life and are often interrupted by divine judgment.
